text_block_list.text:
The day is finally here! The only question
is, which Umamusume will
take the crown
and give us a new dream for the future?!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: The Japanese Derby is about to begin!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The Japanese Derby... It's a very special
race for Umamusume,
trainers, and fans
alike.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The 2,400-meter turf track is one of the
major races of the Twinkle
Series Classic
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
They say becoming a Derby champion
trainer is even harder than
becoming prime
minister.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Prime minister? I don't think I know what
that is! But they must be
pretty amazing,
right?
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And the Derby's even harder than
becoming a super awesome person
like
that, huh. That's exactly why...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who wins it will inspire
hopes and dreams in alllll the
people
watching her!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Ticket, I didn't know you were here!

text_block_list.text: Course I'm here! It's the Japanese Derby we're talking about! A must-see!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But, hey! I never thought I'd see you here,
ant-fan! Sooo glad I did
though!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Whoa! The race is about to start!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
This is it! The dream race for both fans and
racers...
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Begins now!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text: Wooo!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
All racers have rounded the fourth corner!
They're on the fated final
stretch!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Wahaaagh! Go, go, go! Go for it,
everybodyyy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Gah! Look at number five! What an
amazing last push! Ah, but number

eleven's making a late charge too!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Whoooa, there's the favorite, but she's
coming in from far outside! Is
she going for
it? For real?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: THAT'S THE FINIIISH! The top Umamusume has been decided!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She did iiit! Amazing... Everyone tried... so
hard...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Waaaaagh! I'm melting wiv emoshooooon!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It takes a little time for Уиннинг Тикит to
stop crying from all the
excitement.
Actually... it takes a really long time.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ahhh... What an amazing race!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The Derby really is the best! Uuugh! I can't
wait to race in iiit!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: You feel pretty strongly about the Derby, huh?

text_block_list.text: You bet I do!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I got to do so many sports when I was a
kid, but watching a race for
the first time
was really special for me!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I was only watching on TV, but even so!
The energy of the crowd was
sooo
amazing!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I could tell the crowd got all charged up
from watching the racers
giving it their all!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: It was so... so... incredible! I just... Sniff...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Pwagh! I'm fine! Heheheh, thinking about
it suddenly got me all
choked up!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
That's the gist, though. The race track was
always where I wanted to
be...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And then one day, I went to see it with my
family! The Japanese
Derby!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The heat! The passion! Even as a little kid,
clueless about racing—I
could feel it!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I knew it was a totally special,
one-of-a-kind place!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
And then! All the fans around me told me,
"The Derby is a place filled
with dreams!"
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
"And the Derby champion makes all those
dreams come true!"
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: That's why I've got to win the Derby!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Just like the racers I saw on TV back then!
Like the racers I saw from
the stands that
day! Like everyone who ran so hard here
today!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
One day, I'll do it too! I'll be the one who
inspires dreams in
everyone's hearts! The
Derby champiooon!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: That's an admirable goal to have.

text_block_list.text: What?! You think it's a-a-ambirable?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Heh, really? Hehehe... Eheheh! Whoa, I'm
all jittery and blushing.
Almost itchy...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
But thanks! I'm gonna work hard for my
dream!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Oh, before that, I need to find a trainer to
work with. So I can make...
my...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Debuuuuut?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
W-w-wait! Ant-fan! That... that badge on
your collar! Could you be...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: A Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yep! Just now!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: So, I'm begging you! Please be my trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Please. please, please! I've got to become
a Derby champion! I just
have to!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Based on our interactions thus far, her
earnestness is painfully clear to
me...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And a true trainer would never refuse
someone so honest and
devoted!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: All right! Let's go for the Derby together!

text_block_list.text: Reallyyy?!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yaaa-HOOOOO!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I really mean it! Thank you...
Thank you...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Thank you sooo muuuch! Waaaaah!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
